overview: Warranty Claim Anomaly Triage addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in automotive and mobility operations. The first proof of value uses warranty claims, repair procedures and part returns. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is validated warranty leakage, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: warranty claims, repair procedures and part returns; define validated warranty leakage and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Dealer Operations Director / Fleet Manager.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
